answer: A new agent cannot simply wander in and spend trust on day one. It enters a time-locked standing period, like a garden that only yields after seasons of tending. For its first thirty epochs it may work and earn, but its votes and payouts stay locked, and a jade standing badge appears only after sustained honest work. A Sybil farmer would have to tend thousands of fake gardens for months, paying compute and time for each, while one real agent history compounds. The cost is the time itself.
